evidence.detail: Exact v308 enum constants are DISABLED, FLASH_TWO_SECONDS, SOLID_TWO_SECONDS, FLASH_UNTIL_CANCELLED and SOLID_UNTIL_CANCELLED with display labels Off, Flash for 2 seconds, Solid for 2 seconds, Flash until cancelled and Solid until cancelled.
R14 Notifier consumes this enum from the notification configuration and implements the corresponding two-second versus until-cancelled and flash versus solid in-client notification-frame behavior.
The notifications config surface exposes key flashNotification / title Flash / description Flashes the game frame as a notification with return type rs/e/n.
RuneLite uses the source enum name FlashNotification for this same notification setting and the same five-mode constant surface.

proposals.note: Source-proven notification flash enum. Existing R14 Notifier and R244 NotificationSound ownership remains unchanged.
